Definition: from G2095 and G701; fully agreeable:--acceptable(-ted), wellpleasing.
BiblicalUsage: Euárestos means well-pleasing — fully agreeable to God. Paul says to present our bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God; and to prove what is acceptable unto the Lord; and children who obey their parents are well pleasing unto the Lord. It is the word for what God receives with gladness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe euárestos is the test of my offering: not whether it is impressive, but whether it pleases Him. I hold that a life offered to God is acceptable because He says so, not because I feel so.
